title: Single blind pairwise judge output
description: The StructuredOutput one independent judge returns for ONE fixture. The judge saw the task, the rubric dimensions, and TWO neutrally labelled artifacts 'Output A' / 'Output B' — it was NOT told which arm (library/baseline) is which. For each rubric dimension it picks a blind winner (A|B|tie), a normalized 0..1 margin, and a one-line quoted-evidence justification; then an overall winner+margin. The runner collects N=3 of these (position randomized per judge), aggregates per dimension by MAJORITY winner + MEDIAN margin into result.schema.json's judge block, and records the A<->arm map in blinding_map AFTER judging. per_dimension[*].{dimension,winner,margin} binds exactly to result.schema.json#/$defs/dimensionVerdict (plus the extra evidence string); overall binds to #/$defs/verdict. Top level is a plain object with NO allOf/oneOf/anyOf — a workflow StructuredOutput constraint; composition lives only inside $defs.

per_dimension.description: One verdict per rubric dimension, in the order the dimensions were presented. dimension keys must join to fixture.rubric.dimensions[].key.

overall.description: This judge's overall winner+margin across all dimensions. Lean 'tie' when the per-dimension picks do not point clearly one way.

winner.description: Blind winner in A/B terms only. The judge never knows which arm A or B is. 'tie' is a first-class answer — pick it under weak evidence, never to break it.

margin.description: Normalized strength of the win, 0..1. MUST be 0 when winner is 'tie'. Small margins (<=0.2) are correct when one side is only marginally ahead.

judgeDimensionVerdict.description: Per-dimension blind verdict. The dimension/winner/margin triple binds to result.schema.json#/$defs/dimensionVerdict; 'evidence' is the extra quoted-justification string this single-judge layer carries (the aggregator drops it when collapsing the panel into the result's dimensionVerdict).

dimension.description: Rubric dimension key this verdict scores; joins to fixture.rubric.dimensions[].key.

winner.description: Blind winner for this dimension. Default to 'tie' when the quoted evidence does not clearly favor one side.

margin.description: Normalized 0..1 margin for this dimension; MUST be 0 when winner is 'tie'.

evidence.description: One-line justification that QUOTES the deciding text from the winning (or, for a tie, each) output. Must reference the artifact content, not restate the rubric. A verdict without a quote is unevidenced — record 'tie'.
